## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL regime. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive; confirmations: mixed sector leadership (Energy, Utilities, Financials, Healthcare positive vs Tech, Industrials, Consumer Discretionary weak) and pronounced large-cap divergences (multiple mega-caps with 1W ≠ 1M), signaling no clear directional bet.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leads: XOM (1W: +1.76% | 1M: +3.66%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +3.34% | 1M: +11.20%) ABOVE TREND. Utilities strong: VST (1W: +8.91% | 1M: +5.60%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +8.03% | 1M: +14.68%) ABOVE TREND. Financials mild strength: JPM (1W: +0.29% | 1M: +0.66%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology lagging overall: GOOGL (1W: -2.28% | 1M: -5.33%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -2.69% | 1M: +0.16%) CORRECTION. Industrials weak: UNP (1W: -5.35% | 1M: -1.50%) BELOW TREND, LMT (1W: -6.26% | 1M: -9.32%) BELOW TREND. Communication under pressure: TTWO (1W: -8.79% | 1M: -7.65%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: DE (1W: +10.03% | 1M: +12.80%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +8.91% | 1M: +5.60%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +8.03% | 1M: +14.68%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +7.07% | 1M: -4.02%) RECOVERY, META (1W: +6.70% | 1M: +4.56%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Moderate concentration (Top 5 across 3 sectors), style: mixed / no clear leadership.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: UNP (1W: -5.35% | 1M: -1.50%) BELOW TREND, BKNG (1W: -6.00% | 1M: -6.80%) BELOW TREND, LMT (1W: -6.26% | 1M: -9.32%) BELOW TREND, PLTR (1W: -6.42% | 1M: +11.81%) CORRECTION, MNST (1W: -6.49% | 1M: -6.92%) BELOW TREND.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Top 1W movers: DE (1W: +10.03% | 1M: +12.80%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +8.91% | 1M: +5.60%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +8.03% | 1M: +14.68%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +7.07% | 1M: -4.02%) RECOVERY, NVDA (1W: +5.89% | 1M: +5.19%) ABOVE TREND — watch INTC and other 1W/1M divergences as tactical opportunities, not confirmation of a new regime.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed with signs of rotation: NVDA (1W: +5.89% | 1M: +5.19%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +6.70% | 1M: +4.56%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +5.26% | 1M: +10.67%) ABOVE TREND, while MSFT (1W: -2.69% | 1M: +0.16%) CORRECTION and GOOGL (1W: -2.28% | 1M: -5.33%) BELOW TREND. Sector technicals weak on 1W: Technology sector 1W: -0.70% (24 stocks) — internal rotation.

8. Financials Outlook?
Cautious constructive: JPM (1W: +0.29% | 1M: +0.66%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: -1.71% | 1M: +1.43%) CORRECTION, MA (1W: -2.70% | 1M: +0.57%) CORRECTION — Financials 1W: +0.43% (20 stocks), breadth mixed but not collapsing.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Defensive parts holding: JNJ (1W: +2.68% | 1M: +7.63%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +1.75% | 1M: +8.59%) ABOVE TREND, while LLY (1W: -2.15% | 1M: -3.43%) BELOW TREND and UNH (1W: +1.07% | 1M: -1.69%) RECOVERY — Healthcare 1W: +0.15% (17 stocks), mixed but supportive.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure to select Energy and Utilities leaders (XOM, CVX, VST) and high-conviction cyclicals showing momentum (DE, MPC) while reducing exposure to names with short-term trend exhaustion in Tech (MSFT, ADBE, PANW). Maintain nimble sizing given NEUTRAL regime and sizable 1W/1M divergences.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: NVDA (1W: +5.89% | 1M: +5.19%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +6.70% | 1M: +4.56%) ABOVE TREND, DE (1W: +10.03% | 1M: +12.80%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: MSFT (1W: -2.69% | 1M: +0.16%) CORRECTION, GOOGL (1W: -2.28% | 1M: -5.33%) BELOW TREND, ADBE (1W: -8.58% | 1M: +2.41%) CORRECTION.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +2.76% | 1M: +13.73%) — breadth support; Utilities (1W: +2.10% | 1M: +0.81%) showing merger-driven strength. BEARISH: Technology (1W: -0.70% | 1M: +2.14%) and Industrials (1W: -1.76% | 1M: -3.84%) — watch for spillover if big-cap tech fails to stabilize.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA (1W: +5.89% | 1M: +5.19%) ABOVE TREND: hold above recent breakout to confirm extension; AAPL (1W: +0.08% | 1M: +2.51%) ABOVE TREND: failure to hold short-term support would signal broader tech pressure; MSFT (1W: -2.69% | 1M: +0.16%) CORRECTION: reclaim of short-term trend required to remove downside risk.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
D (+90): NextEra–Dominion merger clears votes — cross-ref price: DE is (1W: +10.03% | 1M: +12.80%) ABOVE TREND; sentiment confirms sector M&A strength. XOM (+50): Exxon operator role in LNG story — cross-ref price: XOM (1W: +1.76% | 1M: +3.66%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirming. LLY (+50): large incretin opportunity headline — cross-ref price: LLY (1W: -2.15% | 1M: -3.43%) BELOW TREND, sentiment diverges from price.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
F (-55): Ford recall headlines but price rising — F (1W: +5.33% | 1M: +7.17%) ABOVE TREND, news-price divergence (distribution risk to monitor). ADBE (-45): AI-era pressure headline and 1W weakness — ADBE (1W: -8.58% | 1M: +2.41%) CORRECTION, news confirming downside. PLTR (-45): governance/quality questions — PLTR (1W: -6.42% | 1M: +11.81%) CORRECTION, sentiment aligned with 1W weakness.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime, style mixed / no clear leadership. Energy and Utilities showing relative strength: XOM (1W: +1.76% | 1M: +3.66%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +3.34% | 1M: +11.20%) ABOVE TREND, DE (1W: +10.03% | 1M: +12.80%) ABOVE TREND. Key risk: large-cap divergences (MSFT CORRECTION, INTC RECOVERY, LLY BELOW TREND) and several bullish headlines with lagging prices—monitor for trend confirmation before increasing directional exposure.
